notes: t_6b1e01ff, scripted from the batch 14 live run (t_b611e0af, playbook playbooks/build/chamberofcommerce.com.md). One-page wizard at /members/add-business: BusinessName, Address, PostalCode (#PostalCodeLookup: type key by key then Tab, City #cityselectdropdown and State #stateselectdropdown fill themselves), Phone #phone (digits only), Category is a select2 (value 784 'Business Management Consultant'), first/last name, email + confirmation = listings@, passwords #Password / #Password2 from the vault. reCAPTCHA v2 sitekey 6LdpAPgZAAAAACrg_DlLkvOwaV99pMM8zIce14Yo (CapSolver, 1 solve; callbacks 0 is fine). Submit is the 'Add My Business' anchor. /members/activate-my-account wants the Activation Key mailed to listings@ (subject 'ChamberofCommerce.com Activation Email'): typed into input[name=activationkey], then 'Verify My Account'. That lands on my.chamberofcommerce.com/business/<id>; the wizard never collects website or email, so #website and #email are filled there and 'Save My Business' clicked (page says up to 24 hours). Leave Suppress Phone unchecked. The map pin needs a premium plan: never pay for the Member upgrade. Public page is created-unlisted for up to 24h: recheck the day after. NOT live-verified as a script yet: the category control id and the key's exact wording in the mail are from the hand run; the mail regex takes the token after 'Activation Key', so check the first live run's mail line.
